Definition: Kirjath-Jearim or Kirjath-Arim, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Kirjath-jearim is listed among the Gibeonite cities, and when the Philistines send the ark back, the men of Kirjath-jearim fetch it up into the house of Abinadab, and sanctify Eleazar his son to keep it. The ark rests there until David comes for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ark resting twenty years in one man's house is the quiet middle of the story, and Abinadab's hill kept it safe.
RelatedPeople: Abinadab of Kirjath-jearim; Eleazar, Son of Abinadab; King David
